blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Chemical chain-of-thought can contain hallucinated structural and property claims. We thereby introduce MolLean, a process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state. A layered Lean-based kernel checks state transitions and assertions over molecular readouts, from primitive graph edits to compound transformations. Meanwhile, a typed witness protocol separates native structural checks from externally supplied measurements. We further introduce MolLean-MCP, a stateful tool interface that exposes these transitions, checks, and readouts during generation: the model receives feedback to decide its next action, and rejected actions leave the state unchanged. MolLean supports one-pass trace execution, whole-trace refinement, and interactive reasoning through MolLean-MCP. We evaluate these three modes with direct chain-of-thought on 8,800 matched examples across 12 tasks spanning molecular generation, editing, optimization, and reactions. With Qwen3.6-27B, whole-trace refinement outperforms direct chain-of-thought on all 12 tasks. MolLean-MCP complements whole-trace refinement with stepwise verification feedback, reaching better performance in reaction tasks. Together, these results highlight an executable foundation for chemical reasoning, in which explicit chemical commitments can be checked and revised rather than remaining solely in free-form explanations.
blocks.zh: 化学思维链可以包含幻觉结构和财产索赔. 我们由此引入了Molean,一种过程可验证的语言,它使化学推理具有明显的分子状态. 一个分层的基于Lean的内核检查状态过渡和断言超过分子读取,从原始图编辑到复合变换. 同时,一个打字的证人协议将本地结构检查与外部提供的测量区分开来. 我们进一步引入了Mollean-MCP,这是一种状态化的工具界面,它暴露了这些转换,检查,和生成过程中的读取:模型收到反馈来决定其下一步行动,拒绝的行动则让状态保持不变. Molean支持单路跟踪执行,全轨修饰,并通过Molean-MCP进行交互推理. 我们用8,800个对应的例子来评估这三种模式, 包括分子生成、编辑、优化和反应。 随着Quen3.6-27B,全轨完善在所有12项任务上都超越了直接的思维链. Molean-MCP通过逐步的核查反馈来补充整个跟踪的完善,在反应任务中达到更好的性能. 这些结果共同突出了化学推理的可执行基础,其中可以检查和修订明确的化学承诺,而不是仅仅停留在自由形式的解释中。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Chain-of-thought prompting makes a model’s intermediate reasoning visible ( Wei et al., 2022 ) . In chemistry, this is appealing as chemists could examine the intermediate reasoning steps to improve the explainability of the final answer ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Narayanan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . However, a model can invoke a functional group absent from a molecule, lose track of a bond, or claim a property improvement without establishing it. Analyses of chemical reasoning find fabricated structural claims even alongside correct answers ( Li et al., 2026b ) , and broader evaluations reveal uneven chemical competence and overconfidence ( Mirza et al., 2025 ) . These errors concern the stated chemistry itself, a failure mode complementary to causal unfaithfulness, where an explanation misrepresents how the answer was produced ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 思维链的提示使模型的中间推理可见(Wei等,2022.). 在化学方面,这是有吸引力的,因为化学家可以审查中间推理步骤,以改善最终答案的可解释性(Wang等,2026;Narayanan等,2026;Li等,2025;赵等,2025)。 然而,一个模型可以引用一个分子中缺失的功能组,失去连接的轨迹,或者要求财产改良而不加以证实. 对化学推理的分析发现,即使有正确的答案(Li等人,2026年b),也存在捏造的结构性主张,更广泛的评价显示,化学能力不均和过度自信(Mirza等人,2025年)。 这些错误涉及所陈述的化学本身,是一种与因果关系相补充的失败模式,在这种模式下,解释会歪曲答案是如何产生的(Turpin等,2023年)。

blocks.en: We therefore ask what must a chemical reasoning language represent for its steps to be verifiable? Lean offers a precedent: a model proposes a derivation and a proof assistant checks its formal obligations ( Moura and Ullrich, 2021 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) . Chemical reasoning combines graph transformations, structural observations, empirical estimates, and choices among plausible candidates. Chemistry tools already support capable agents ( M. Bran et al., 2024 ; Boiko et al., 2023 ) ; the key step is to give successive operations and claims a shared molecular referent and an explicit acceptance condition.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们问,化学推理语言必须代表什么才能使其步骤得到核查? Lean提供了一个先例:一个模型提出了一个推论,一个证明助理检查其正式义务(Moura and Ullrich, 2021;Jiang等人, 2023;Yang等人, 2023)。 化学推理结合了图变,结构观察,实证估计,以及可信候选人的选择. 化学工具已经支持有能力的物剂(M. Bran等,2024;Boiko等,2023;关键步骤是给予相继的操作,并声称拥有共同的分子参考和明确的接受条件.

blocks.en: We introduce MolLean , a process-verifiable language grounded in a maintained molecular state (Figure 1 ). A transition constructs, modifies, or reorganizes represented molecules. A readout obtains information without changing them, and an assertion tests a claim against that information. The model selects actions and obligations; a Lean-based kernel checks admissible transitions and native structural predicates. Descriptor- and knowledge-dependent assertions obtain typed witnesses from external providers. These distinctions let construction, transformation, and observation share one language while each keeps its own form of evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们引入Molean,一种基于维持分子状态的可过程验证语言(图1). 过渡结构、改变或重组代表分子。 读取信息而不改变信息,而断言则根据该信息检验索赔。 该模式选择行动和义务;一个基于精益的内核检查可接受过渡和本土结构上方。 描述和知识依赖的说法从外部提供者那里获得打字证人。 这些区别使得构造、转化和观察都使用一种语言,而每种语言都保留自己的证据形式。

blocks.en: The state does more than record the output: it determines which atoms a later edit addresses, which molecule a property readout measures, and whether an accepted prefix remains usable after a failed proposal. MolLean supports primitive edits, construction macros, joint transformations, and candidate introduction at different granularities. An accepted edit supplies the referent for subsequent checks, and a rejected edit leaves the maintained state intact. Verification thus applies directly to the model’s declared commitments.
blocks.zh: 状态不只记录输出:它决定哪个原子是后期编辑地址,哪个原子是分子属性读出量度,以及一个被接受的前缀在失败后是否仍然可用. Molean支持原始编辑,构造宏,联合转化,以及在不同颗粒上候选的引入. 一个被接受的编辑为后续检查提供参考文献,一个被拒绝的编辑让保持状态完好无损. 因此,核查直接适用于模式宣布的承诺。

blocks.en: We expose the same language through whole-trace and interactive interfaces. MolLean One-pass submits a complete trace; MolLean Refinement revises a rejected trace from the initial state. MolLean-MCP lets the model inspect the current state, attempt an operation, and use immediate feedback to choose its next action. External feedback is central to revision: tool-grounded criticism guides reasoning more reliably than intrinsic self-correction ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) . MolLean specifies what that feedback refers to and when it commits a change.
blocks.zh: 我们通过整个追踪和互动接口来揭露同样的语言. 摩 伦 One-pass 提交完整的跟踪; Molean Finement 从初始状态修改一个被拒绝的跟踪. Molean-MCP让模型检查当前状态,尝试操作,并使用即时反馈来选择其下个动作. 外部反馈是修订的核心:基于工具的批评指导推理比内在自我修正更可靠(黄等,2024;高等,2024). Molean 指定该反馈指的是什么,以及何时进行更改。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • A state-grounded chemical reasoning language and verification contract. MolLean unifies molecular transitions, readouts, and assertions, with explicit boundaries between native structural checks and externally witnessed claims. • Two feedback regimes over shared execution semantics. Whole-trace refinement revises complete traces from the input; MolLean-MCP interacts with the maintained state and commits only accepted edits. • An evaluation on 8,800 matched examples across 12 tasks. With Qwen3.6-27B, refinement improves over direct chain-of-thought on every task, and MCP reaches the highest reaction accuracy. On ChEBI-20, refined traces reach 79.0% soundness and 33.1% answer accuracy, identifying task fidelity as the next challenge beyond repairing rejected steps. Qwen3-4B gains substantially on structural tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下: · 以国家为基础的化学推理语言和核查合同。 Molean将分子过渡、读取和断言统一起来,在本地结构检查和外部见证的索赔之间有明确的界限。 二. 支助 两个关于共享执行语义的反馈制度. 全程精细修正了输入的完整痕迹;Molean-MCP与被维护状态交互,只承诺接受编辑. ^ 对8 800项评价与12项任务中的例子相符。 以Quen3.6-27B为单位,精细改进了对每项任务的直接思考链,而MCP达到最高反应精度. 在ChEBI-20上,精细的痕迹达到了79.0%的音效和33.1%的回答精度,将任务忠实确定为除了修复被否定的步骤之外的下一个挑战. Qune3-4B在结构任务方面取得很大进展。

blocks.en: MolLean is a reasoning language built around a simple contract: an operation refers to the current molecular state, verification decides whether it is admissible, and only an accepted transition commits a new state. Readouts and assertions observe that same state without editing it. Lean implements the chemical core, while Python handles parsing, state transport, reference resolution, and inference control (Figure 1 ).

blocks.en: Seven primitives add or remove atoms, form or break bonds, and update bond order, charge, or radicals. They check preconditions and affected valences. Intermediates may be under-saturated to permit construction, and connectivity is enforced by the relevant operation or terminal policy.

blocks.en: Construction macros such as Chain , Ring , and AttachGroup reduce index manipulation. Compound actions express joint bond changes, proton transfer, and fragment separation. Fragment splits a bridge bond into active molecules; Eject moves a separated component into the leaving pool. Named reactions expand into these operations. Most expansions execute in Lean; Python fragment adapters submit operations for the same checks.

blocks.en: Granularity determines the verification unit. A Concerted bundle applies edits atomically and checks the resulting valences once all edits apply. propose introduces a structurally checked candidate in a single step.

blocks.en: Bookkeeping covers graph atoms, formal charge, and radical parity across both pools. Addition, removal, and candidate introduction update the ledger accordingly. blocks.en: A readout associates a query with the state being examined. MolLean supports native checks for seven structural families: atom counts, bond counts, ring counts, molecular formula, aromaticity, built-in functional-group patterns, and retained R/S stereocenter annotations. Element counts include implicit as well as explicit hydrogen, while molecular-formula checks require all present elements. Ring counts use a graph-theoretic definition.

blocks.en: 2.5 Whole-Trace and Interactive Inference
blocks.zh: 2.5 全程追踪和互动推论

blocks.en: MolLean One-pass executes a generated complete trace until acceptance or the first rejection. MolLean Refinement starts from that same completion, returning rejection feedback and indexed state to the model. It revises rejected traces within a fixed budget, restarting each at S 0 S_{0} and stopping once accepted. Thus the model can replace its entire plan after a failure.
blocks.zh: 摩 伦 One-pass 执行生成的完整跟踪直到接受或第一次拒绝. Molean Fiinement从同一完成开始,返回拒绝反馈,并将状态索引到模型. 它修改了固定预算内被拒绝的痕迹,在S0 S_{0}重新开始,一旦被接受就停止。 因此,模型可以在失败后取代其整个计划.

blocks.en: MolLean-MCP exposes transitions, checks, and readouts as stateful tools, supplied to the model as function-calling schemas within the inference loop. The model can inspect the state before choosing its next operation; rejected proposals leave it unchanged. finish invokes closing gates. MCP uses the language interactively; One-pass and Refinement submit complete programs.
blocks.zh: Molean-MCP将转换、检查和读出暴露为状态工具,作为推论圈内的函数调用计划提供给模型。 该模型在选择下一步操作之前可以检查该州;被否决的建议书没有改变. 关闭大门。 MCP以交互方式使用语言; One-pass and Finement 提交完整的程序.

blocks.en: Verification compares only against the input or a self-proposed candidate; dataset references enter only the independent scorer (Section 3 ). Each task declares its initialization, allowed operations, closing obligations, and scorer.
blocks.zh: 核查仅与输入或自我提名的候选人进行比较;数据集参考文献只输入独立计分员(第3节)。 每个任务宣布初始化,允许操作,关闭义务,以及计分器.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: We ask whether MolLean improves task performance, how accepted traces relate to correct answers, and when interactive verification is useful. The main comparison uses Qwen3.6-27B; an additional Qwen3-4B evaluation examines whole-trace inference with a smaller model.
blocks.zh: 我们问莫莱恩是否改善了任务性能,被接受的痕迹与正确答案有何关系,以及何时互动核查是有用的。 主要比较使用Quen3.6-27B;另外的Quen3-4B评价用更小的模型考察了全轨推论.

blocks.en: 3.1 Tasks, Protocols, and Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务、协议和计量

blocks.en: All protocols are evaluated on the same 8,800 examples across 12 task types: 500 examples for each of nine S 2 -Bench tasks ( Li et al., 2026a ) , 500 forward and 500 retrosynthesis examples from USPTO-50k ( Schneider et al., 2016 ) , and the complete 3,300-example ChEBI-20 test set ( Edwards et al., 2021 ; Edwards et al., 2022 ) . Reaction classes are supplied to every protocol, and USPTO uses a deterministic reaction-level split. Invalid answers and unsuccessful episodes remain in the denominator.

All MolLean results use the same verifier version; Appendix D.2 details the inference settings.

blocks.en: 3.2 Whole-Trace Refinement Improves Task Performance
blocks.zh: 3.2 全程跟踪改进了任务绩效

blocks.en: Refinement improves over Direct CoT on all 12 task types (Table 1 ), with gains of 12.0–48.2 percentage points under each task’s binary success criterion. For optimization, this range uses direction-only success, and similarity-weighted scores show the same gains. Atom and bond counts improve by 46.8 and 48.2 points, and component addition by 44.2. Paired bootstrap intervals for the primary Refine-minus-CoT score exclude zero in every task (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 改进了所有12个任务类型的直接COT(表1),在每个任务二进制成功标准下,收益为12.0至48.2个百分点。 为了优化,这个范围使用唯向成功,相近加权分数显示相同的收益. 原子和债券计数提高了46.8分和48.2分,增加了44.2分。 初级精准-减-CoT分数的保龄期不包括每项任务中的零(表2)。

blocks.en: One-pass already improves over CoT on 11 tasks. On forward reactions, One-pass (23.6%) trails CoT (35.0%), and refinement raises accuracy to 62.8%, showing that feedback is most valuable when the initial plan misses the verifier’s obligations. Improvements extend to reference-based tasks, with ChEBI-20 accuracy increasing from 18.1% to 33.1% and retrosynthesis from 3.0% to 20.8%. These results identify two complementary benefits: expressing a candidate as an executable trace, and using a failed check to revise that candidate.
blocks.zh: 单行道在11个任务上已经比CoT改进了. 在前方反应方面,One-pass(23.6%)跟踪CoT(35.0 % ) , 精度提升到62.8%,这表明当初始计划错过了核查者的义务时,反馈最有价值。 改进扩大到基于参考的任务,ChEBI-20的精度从18.1%提高到33.1%,再合成从3.0%提高到20.8%. 这些结果确定了两个相辅相成的好处:将一名候选人表示为可执行的追踪,并利用失败的检查来修改该候选人。

In these tasks, the declared obligations capture part of the instruction, and native functional-group patterns follow MolLean’s own definitions.

blocks.en: For ChEBI-20, 1,075 outputs are both sound and correct, 1,533 are sound but incorrect, 17 are correct without certification, and 675 satisfy neither criterion. These exhaustive outcomes distinguish process acceptance from task success (Appendix E.4 ). Atom-count generation shows the opposite profile: 444 of 467 accepted traces meet its task criterion, compared with 1,075 of 2,608 on ChEBI-20. A count maps directly to a predicate, whereas a textual description requires the model to select and combine the right structural obligations. Instruction-to-constraint grounding is therefore the main lever for further gains, as the salt example in Section 4 illustrates.
blocks.zh: 对于ChEBI-20,有1,075个输出既合理又正确,有1,533个输出是合理但不正确的,有17个输出是正确而不经过认证的,有675个输出不符合两个标准. 这些详尽无遗的结果将接受过程与任务成功区分开来(附录E.4). 原子计数生成显示相反的剖面:467个被接受的痕迹中有444个符合其任务标准,而ChEBI-20上的2,608个痕迹中有1,075个符合任务标准. 一个计数地图直接到一个上游,而文字描述则需要模型选择和结合正确的结构义务. 因此,如第4节中的盐分例子所说明的,指令与约束地基是进一步收益的主要杠杆。

blocks.en: 3.4 Interactive Verification Strengthens Reaction Prediction
blocks.zh: 3.4 互动核查加强反应预测

blocks.en: Figure 2 c shows the signed differences between the two interfaces. MCP achieves the best reaction results, with 66.4% forward-reaction and 27.4% retrosynthesis accuracy against 62.8% and 20.8% for Refinement. Refinement leads on atom counts (88.8% versus 82.6%), bond counts (69.0% versus 56.2%), QED optimization (59.0 versus 49.4 weighted-score points), and ChEBI-20 (33.1% versus 23.5%), and both protocols reach 100.0% on component addition and 97.0% on component deletion.
blocks.zh: 图2c显示了两个接口之间的签名差异. MCP实现最佳反应结果,远期反应率为66.4%,再生反应精度为27.4%,而精度为62.8%和20.8%. 精细化导致原子计数(88.8%对82.6%)、债券计数(69.0%对56.2%)、QED优化(59.0%对49.4加权分数点)和ChEBI-20(33.1%对23.5%),两项协议在组件添加方面均达到100.0%,在组件删除方面达到97.0%。

blocks.en: Whole-trace refinement can revise an entire plan, and MCP conditions each action on the maintained state and immediate feedback. Immediate feedback helps the model maintain references across a sequence of dependent edits, as in multi-step reactions, while restarting permits larger changes of plan. The two interfaces are therefore complementary. Appendix E.2 reports the interaction-length distributions.
blocks.zh: 全面跟踪的完善可以修改整个计划,而MCP则将每个行动都建立在保持状态和即时反馈的基础上. 即时反馈有助于模型在一系列依附编辑中保持引用,如多步反应,而重启则允许更大的计划变更. 因此这两个接口是相辅相成的。 附录E.2报告了相互作用的长度分布。

blocks.en: 3.5 Whole-Trace Inference with Qwen3-4B
blocks.zh: 3.5 与Qune3-4B的全轨推论

blocks.en: The smaller-model evaluation shows substantial gains on several structural tasks (Table 3 ). It uses the same task IDs and whole-trace protocols as the main evaluation.
blocks.zh: 规模较小的模型评价显示,在若干结构任务上取得了很大进展(表3)。 它使用与主要评价相同的任务ID和全跟踪协议.

blocks.en: Relative to Direct CoT, refinement raises atom-count success from 15.8% to 56.8%, component addition from 13.4% to 91.4%, substitution from 15.2% to 53.4%, and the logP optimization score from 14.7 to 60.0. Verification-guided refinement therefore transfers to a smaller model.
blocks.zh: 相对于直接交易公司,精细化将原子计数成功率从15.8%提高到56.8%,组件添加率从13.4%提高到91.4%,替代率从15.2%提高到53.4%,对数计算优化得分从14.7%提高到60.0%。 因此,核查指导的改进工作向较小的模式转让。

blocks.en: Reference-based generation remains difficult for the smaller model: after refinement, forward-reaction accuracy is 1.6% (One-pass: 2.2%), ChEBI-20 reaches 1.4%, and retrosynthesis is 0.0% under every protocol. These tasks depend on chemical knowledge that the proposer must supply, so verification is most effective when paired with a capable candidate generator.
blocks.zh: 基于参考的生成对于更小的模型来说仍然是困难的:经过完善后,前向反应精度为1.6%(一通:2.2%),ChEBI-20达到1.4%,再合成在每个协议下为0.0. 这些任务取决于提议者必须提供的化学知识,因此,在与有能力的候选生成器配对时,核查最为有效.

blocks.en: 4 Case Studies: Repairs and Specification Gaps
blocks.zh: 4 案例研究:修理和规格差距

blocks.en: Figure 4 pairs molecular structures with verification feedback in six cases, illustrating how rejected commitments are repaired and how an accepted revision can still miss the intended task.
blocks.zh: 图4对分子结构进行了6次核查反馈,说明如何修复被拒绝的承诺,以及接受的修订如何仍然可能错过预定任务。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Molecular cases of repair and incomplete specification. (a,c) Refinement changes action granularity or the attachment site. (b,e) A property or count assertion rejects an otherwise valid candidate. (d) MCP repairs an edit within the same maintained state. (f) A revised salt description drops a required component, giving an accepted but incorrect answer. Molecular drawings use the saved structures; numbers in (c,d) denote input atom indices. Refinement restarts from the task input, whereas MCP continues within its episode.
blocks.zh: 图4:分子修复案例和不完全规格. (a,c) 改进改变动作颗粒性或附件站点。 (b) (e) 财产或计数主张拒绝原有效候选人。 (d) MCP 在同一保持状态内修复一个编辑器。 (f) 经修订的盐类说明降低了所需的成分,给出了可接受的但错误的答案。 分子图纸使用所保存的结构;(c,d)中的数字表示输入原子指数. 完善从任务输入重新开始,而MCP则在其插曲内继续.

blocks.en: In the forward-reaction example (a), forming a bond to an acyl carbon before breaking its bond to chlorine would give carbon valence five. The one-pass trace is rejected. Refinement replaces the sequential edits with a joint bond-formation and bond-cleavage operation, removes the detached chlorine, and obtains the correct carbonate product. The aldehyde-addition example (c) instead needs a different attachment site: the same AttachGroup macro fails at substituted aromatic carbon 10 and succeeds at carbon 11. The revised trace then passes the functional-group-change and input-relative similarity checks. The carbonate requires suitable action granularity, whereas the aldehyde requires a suitable molecular referent.
blocks.zh: 在前向反应例子(a)中,在与氯断接之前与乙酰碳形成结合,将使碳值达到5。 单行道追踪被拒绝. 完善后用联键成型和联键分解操作来取代相继编辑,去除脱去的氯,得到正确的碳酸盐产物. 醛加成例 (c) 需要不同的附件站点: 同一附件组宏在取代芳香碳10时失败,在碳11时成功. 修改后的追踪通过功能组变化和输入相对相似性检查. 碳酸盐需要适当的活性颗粒,而高醛则需要适当的分子比对.

blocks.en: In (b), the one-pass edits lower QED ( Bickerton et al., 2012 ) from 0.674 to 0.573 despite an instruction to increase it. The graph edits pass, and the property assertion fails. Refinement reaches QED 0.767, with success-weighted similarity 0.743. RDKit supplies the measurement and Lean checks the requested direction. In (e), a valid 27-carbon chain fails AtomCount because the instruction requests 25. Refinement proposes a 25-carbon chain and passes that count. Both cases separate candidate validity from the requested property, with different evidence sources: atom count is native to the graph, and QED is an externally computed descriptor checked through a witness.
blocks.zh: 在(b)中,单行道编辑的QED(Bickerton等,2012年)从0.674到0.573,尽管指示增加. 图表编辑通过,属性断言失败 。 完善后达到QED 0.767,成功加权相近0.743. RDKit提供测量,Lean检查所要求的方向. 在(e)中,有效的27-碳链因指令要求25而失效。 完善提出25-碳链,通过计数. 这两个案件将候选人的有效性与所请求的财产分开,并有不同的证据来源:原子计数是图中原生的,而QED是通过证人核查的外部计算描述符。

blocks.en: In (d), MCP’s phenyl attachment at carbon 5 is refused without changing the state. The next edit attaches it to nitrogen 1, followed by two checks. The episode finishes correctly after four counted calls, including the refusal. In (f), one-pass proposes the correct salt and fails the disconnected-proposal check. Refinement omits chloride and its count obligation, producing an accepted cation that misses the target salt. Effective revision therefore requires both accurate execution and a specification that continues to express what the user asked for.
blocks.zh: 在(d)中,在不改变状态的情况下拒绝将MCP的苯基附加于碳5。 接下来的编辑附加到氮一上,然后进行两次检查. 剧集在4个计数的电话之后,包括拒绝后,完成的正确. 在(f)项中,单行道建议正确的盐分,但未能进行断开的建议书检查。 精细省去氯化物及其计数义务,生成一个被接受的克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克. 因此,有效修订既需要准确执行,也需要继续说明用户要求的规格。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Chemical language research connects molecular representations with natural-language descriptions and instructions. Text2Mol introduced text-based molecular retrieval and ChEBI-20 ( Edwards et al., 2021 ) ; MolT5 studied translation between molecular and natural-language representations ( Edwards et al., 2022 ) ; and Speak-to-Structure evaluates instruction-driven generation, editing, and optimization ( Li et al., 2026a ) . SELFIES addresses molecular-string validity ( Krenn et al., 2020 ) , whereas structural reasoning targets molecular understanding ( Jang et al., 2025 ) . ChemBench evaluates chemical knowledge and reasoning more broadly ( Mirza et al., 2025 ) . These perspectives complement evidence that fluent chemical reasoning can contain unreliable structural claims ( Li et al., 2026b ) . Among executable chemical languages, XDL expresses synthesis procedures for compilation into laboratory instructions ( Mehr et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 化学语言研究将分子表达与自然语言描述和说明联系起来. Text2Mol引入了基于文本的分子检索和ChEBI-20(Edwards等,2021年;MolT5研究了分子和自然语言表达之间的翻译(Edwards等,2022年;Speak-to-Structure评价了指令驱动的生成,编辑,和优化(Li等,2026年a. SELFIES处理分子弦有效性(Krenn等,2020年),而结构推理则针对分子理解(Jang等,2025年). Chem Bench更广义地评价化学知识和推理(Mirza等人,2025年)。 这些观点补充了流利的化学推理可能包含不可靠的结构主张的证据(Li等,2026b.). 在可执行的化学语言中,XDL表达合成程序以被汇编成实验室指令(Mehr等,2020.).

blocks.en: Formal and executable reasoning make different parts of a derivation checkable. Lean separates proof construction from proof checking ( Moura and Ullrich, 2021 ) ; Draft, Sketch, and Prove links informal planning to formal proofs ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , and LeanDojo supports programmatic interaction with Lean ( Yang et al., 2023 ) . Learned process supervision evaluates intermediate reasoning with a trained verifier ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) . PAL and Program of Thoughts use execution to ground generated computations ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 正式和可执行的推理使衍生物的不同部分可以核查。 Lean将校正构建与校正验证区分开来(Moura and Ullrich, 2021; Draft, Sketch, and Prove将非正式规划与正式校正(Jiang等人, 2023)),而LeanDojo支持与Lean的方案互动(Yang等人, 2023). 学习过程监督用经过培训的核查人员来评价中间推理(Lightman等人,2024年)。 PAL和思想方案利用执行方式进行生成的计算(Gao等,2023;Chen等,2023)。

blocks.en: Feedback and tool use turn evaluation into part of generation. Self-Refine uses model-generated feedback ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) , and CRITIC grounds revision in external tools ( Gou et al., 2024 ) , which is more reliable than intrinsic self-correction on reasoning tasks ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . ReAct interleaves reasoning and actions ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . In chemistry, ChemCrow integrates specialized tools ( M. Bran et al., 2024 ) , Coscientist connects planning with experimental automation ( Boiko et al., 2023 ) , and ChemReasoner steers catalyst search using computational-chemistry feedback ( Sprueill et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 反馈和工具的使用将评价变成生成的一部分。 Self-Refine使用模型生成的反馈(Madaan等,2023年),外部工具中的CRITIC理由修订(Gou等,2024年),在推理任务上比内在的自我修正更可靠(Huang等,2024年). ReAct interleaves 推理与行动(姚等,2023.). 在化学中,ChemCrow整合了专业工具(M. Bran等,2024年),宇宙学家将规划与实验自动化相接(Boiko等,2023年),ChemReasoner利用计算-化学反馈来引导催化剂搜索(Sprueill等,2024年).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: MolLean grounds chemical reasoning in a maintained molecular state, combining Lean-checked obligations with explicit external witnesses. MolLean-MCP makes this feedback available during generation. Whole-trace refinement improves Qwen3.6-27B performance across all 12 tasks, MCP delivers the strongest reaction results, and Qwen3-4B gains substantially on structural tasks. Grounding instructions in explicit constraints is the natural next step toward chemical reasoning that is both verifiable and faithful to the task.
blocks.zh: 分子在保持分子状态下进行化学推理,把精度检查的义务和明确的外部证人结合起来. Molean-MCP在生成时提供这种反馈. 全轨改进改进了Quen3.6-27B在所有12个任务中的性能,MCP能提供最强的反应结果,而Quen3-4B在结构任务上也取得了很大收益. 明确限制的指示是朝着化学推理方向迈出的自然的下一步,这种推理既可核查,又忠实于这项任务。

blocks.en: A molecular graph stores indexed atoms, bonds, and stereochemical annotations. Atom fields include element, formal charge, radicals, aromaticity, and virtual hydrogen information; bond fields specify endpoints and order. Virtual hydrogens contribute to element and formula readouts, and the bookkeeping ledger counts graph atoms. The leaving_pool is excluded from the predicted answer and remains part of that ledger. Additions, removals, and proposals update the atom-count ledger.
blocks.zh: 一个分子图存储了索引原子,债券,和立体化学说明. 原子字段包括元素,正电荷,基分,芳香度,和虚拟氢信息;债券字段指定了终点和顺序. 虚拟氢能有助于元素和公式读取,而账簿分类账计算出图表原子. 离开库被排除在预测答案之外,仍然是该分类账的一部分。 添加、去除和建议更新原子计数分类账。

blocks.en: References are pairs (mol_id, atom_idx) into the graph state. A cross-molecule bond joins two index spaces, and a fragment split creates a new molecule identifier. In whole-trace execution, Python tracks accepted primitive merges and remaps subsequent step references through that history. Lean separately rebases references inside tracked compound bundles. MCP uses the current atom map returned in feedback for later model calls. Python also exports the maintained graphs to molecular strings.
blocks.zh: 引用为对(mol_id,原子-idx)入图态. 一个跨分子的结合会加入两个索引空格,而一个片段的分割会形成一个新的分子识别符. 在全跟踪执行中,Python轨迹接受原始合并,并重映后续步骤引用通过该历史. 在履带式复合物捆绑物内 单独进行参照 MCP使用当前返回的原子图作为反馈,用于后期的模型调用. Python还将所保存的图表导出为分子字符串.

blocks.en: A.2 Action Dispatch and Commit Semantics
blocks.zh: A.2 行动调度和语义学

blocks.en: Complete traces are JSON objects with a trace array. A step identifies an operation family, for example op with a primitive, macro with a construction macro, compound with a joint transformation, or assert with a claim. SMILES proposals are parsed into graphs before validation. MCP functions translate to these same step representations and run on the same chemical kernel.
blocks.zh: 完整的痕迹是带有痕量阵列的JSON天体. 一个步骤可以识别一个操作家族,例如用原始的操作来操作,用建筑的宏来操作,用联合转换来操作的复合体,或者用索赔来断言. SMILES的建议书在验证前被分解成图表. MCP函数会转换为这些同级表示并运行在同级化学内核上.

blocks.en: Listing 2 summarizes the dispatch path. Lean returns either an accepted state or a structured error. The runtime replaces the maintained state only after acceptance. A failed operation can therefore report an attempted edit without adding it to the accepted trace. Native assertions and external comparisons inspect the molecular graph without changing it.

blocks.en: Primitive edits validate their preconditions and affected valences. A concerted bundle validates its joint outcome, which accommodates edits whose sequential ordering would pass through a temporarily over-valent graph. The closing procedure checks charge and radical bookkeeping and the task’s terminal obligations. Realizability and single-output requirements are task dependent (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: D.1 Task Setup and Scoring
blocks.zh: D.1 任务设置和校正

blocks.en: Generation begins from an empty state; editing and optimization begin from the input molecule. Forward prediction begins from reactants and retrosynthesis from the product. Editing requires one active output molecule and disallows whole-molecule replacement, while optimization permits candidate proposals. Generation, ChEBI-20, and reaction tasks use terminal realizability checks. Closing bookkeeping applies throughout.
blocks.zh: 生成从空态开始;编辑和优化从输入分子开始. 前向预测从反应剂开始,再由产物合成. 编辑需要有一个活性输出分子,不允许全分子替换,而优化则允许候选人提案. 生成,CHEBI-20,和反应任务使用终端可实现性检查. 关闭簿记一直适用。

blocks.en: Non-reaction tasks score the first active molecule; reactions score the full active set. A rejected whole-trace completion can still provide a scored answer from its available state, or a parsed answer when no state is returned. Failed certification can therefore coexist with a correct answer. Missing or invalid answers receive zero. Selected episodes ending in context exhaustion are no-results, remain in the denominator, and receive zero score and certification; CoT and One-pass answers for the same example are scored independently.
blocks.zh: 非反应任务得分第一活性分子;反应得分全部活性集合. 一个被拒绝的全轨补全仍然可以提供来自其可用状态的得分答案,或者在没有状态返回时解析答案. 因此,失败的认证可以与正确的答案并存. 缺少或无效的答案得到零。 结束于上下文耗尽的选集是无结果的,留在分母中,并获得零分和认证; CoT 和 One-pass 答案是独立得分的.

blocks.en: ChEBI-20 uses its full supplied test split. USPTO selection uses MD5 ⁡ ( reaction key ) mod 100 ≥ 90 \operatorname{MD5}(\text{reaction key})\bmod 100\geq 90 , with a key combining patent identifier and row index. Forward and reverse versions of a reaction remain on the same side. We evaluate 500 examples per direction and supply reaction class names to all protocols. blocks.en: D.2 Inference Settings
blocks.zh: D.2 推论设置

blocks.en: Whole-trace refinement uses a 32,768-token context, temperature 0.3, up to 12,000 requested output tokens, and at most eight revisions after the initial one-pass completion. It stops at acceptance, its budget limit, or an early failure, with parse handling as described in Appendix B . The task reference is excluded from verifier feedback and used only for answer scoring.
blocks.zh: 全轨改进采用32,768个接上下文,温度为0.3,最多可有12,000个所请求的输出令牌,并最多在初始一通完成后有8个修订. 它在接受、预算限额或提前失败时停止,并按附录B所述进行处理。 任务参考被排除在核查反馈之外,只用于答题分.

blocks.en: MCP requests a 65,536-token context, temperature 0.7, and 4,096 output tokens per model call, with at most two attempts, 30 counted action/check calls, and 10 refusals per attempt. Read-only measure and show_state calls and the closing finish call are outside that call counter. The first certified attempt is selected; otherwise the final attempt supplies the outcome.
